_comments.name: What the daemon calls itself in /help, /status and the boot announce. Default 'Leash'.
_comments.defaultCwd: Where sessions start. Empty = ~/dev if it exists, else $HOME.
_comments.claudeBin: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = auto-detect.
_comments.model: Empty = whatever your claude CLI defaults to. Or e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku'.
_comments.yolo: 'true' passes --dangerously-skip-permissions (headless runs can't answer prompts). 'false' uses acceptEdits.
_comments.ownerName: What the assistant calls you when reporting on background work.
_comments.ownerTz: IANA timezone for /account, /usage and /status reset clocks (e.g. 'Europe/Lisbon'). Empty = this machine's local zone.
_comments.timeoutMs: Kill a CHAT-lane task after this long. Default 30 minutes, because you're waiting on the reply.
_comments.bgTimeoutMs: Kill a BACKGROUND worker after this long. Default 8 hours, because that lane is for hour-scale jobs.
_comments.staleSec: Ignore messages older than this (e.g. queued while the machine slept). Default 1 hour.
_comments.engine: Which engine each lane runs on by default: {"chat":"claude","bg":"claude"}. A bare string ('codex') sets both. /engine changes it for this chat at runtime, and a 'codex:' or 'claude:' prefix pins one message.
_comments.codexBin: The OpenAI Codex CLI, for the second engine (/codex, /engine codex and the rate-limit fallback). Optional: with no binary installed every Codex path says so and nothing else changes.
_comments.codexTimeoutMs: Kill a Codex run after this long. Default 30 minutes. 0 disarms the deadline. A Codex run is billed per token and cannot be steered, so an unbounded one is worse than a killed one.
_comments.codexModel: Empty = whatever the codex CLI itself defaults to. /codex model changes it for this chat.
_comments.codexEffort: Empty = CLI default. Or 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh'. /codex effort changes it for this chat.
_comments.codexAppServer: 'true' runs the Codex CHAT lane on `codex app-server`, which is what gives it mid-turn steering, streamed tool steps and a real /stop. 'false' pins it to one-shot `codex exec`. Background Codex jobs always use exec, because they must outlive this daemon.
_comments.codexHandoffNetwork: false runs the FIRST Codex turn that carries a handoff from the other engine with network access off. Model-written text entering a workspace-write run is the one exfiltration surface the handoff adds; set true only if you need that turn online.
_comments.handoffCaptureTurn: true lets the engine you are LEAVING spend one short turn writing the handoff (goal, decisions, files, open question) before the switch. false always builds it from the on-disk chat ring instead, which never needs a model to be up.
_comments.style: {"noDashes": true} rewrites em and en dashes out of every outbound reply, on both engines, leaving code spans, fenced blocks and URLs alone. Default false: the model keeps its own voice.
_comments.progress: {"background": false} turns off the live 🌙 line a background worker keeps on screen from dispatch to done. Default true.
_comments.bgTailMs: How often the daemon polls a detached worker's log file, in ms. This replaces the stdout pipe. Default 300.
_comments.reattachPollMs: How often to check whether a worker that outlived a daemon restart has exited, in ms. Default 5000.
_comments.runLogMaxAgeDays: Delete background run logs older than this at startup. Logs still named by a live worker are kept. Default 7.
_comments.inflightFile: Path to the live-worker registry. Empty = bg-inflight.json next to bridge.mjs. Only change it if the Leash directory is read-only.
_comments.openaiApiKey: Optional. For Whisper voice-note transcription. Usually better set as $OPENAI_API_KEY.
_comments.env-override: Any key can be overridden with BRIDGE_<UPPER_SNAKE_CASE>, e.g. BRIDGE_DEFAULT_CWD.
